metadata.preview:
# Cosmic Dodger

- Control a ship at the bottom of the canvas, moving left/right.
- Meteors fall from the top, speeding up and appearing more often over time.
- Lose if the ship collides with a meteor **or** a meteor reaches the bottom.
- Score is the time survived.

<type>file</type>
<content>
1: // Simple "Cosmic Dodger" game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Audio setup
9:   const bgMusic = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mdn/webaudio-examples/audio/sound-effects/goal.wav');
10:   bgMusic.loop = true;
11:   bgMusic.volume = 0.2;
12:   bgMusic.play().catch(()=>{}); // ignore autoplay restrictions
13:   const hitSound = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mdn/webaudio-examples/audio/sound-effects/short-fail.wav');
14:   const spawnSound = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mdn/webaudio-examples/audio/sound-effects/coin.wav');
15:   const width = canvas.width;
16:   const height = canvas.height;
17: 
18:   // Ship configuration
19:   const ship = {
20:     w: 40,
21:     h: 20,
22:     x: width / 2 - 20,
23:     y: height - 30,
24:     speed: 5,
25:     color: '#0ff',
26:   };
27: 
28:   // Meteor configuration
29:   const meteors = [];
30:   let meteorSpawnInterval = 2000; // ms, will drop
31:   let lastSpawn = 0;
32:   let meteorSpeed = 1.5; // initial fall speed, will increase
33: 
34:   // Input handling
35:   const keys = {};
36:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
37:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
38: 
39:   // Score (seconds survived)
40:   const startTime = performance.now();
41:   let gameOver = false;
42: 
43:   function update(dt) {
44:     // Move ship
45:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
46:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.x += ship.speed;
47:     // Clamp ship inside canvas
48:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
49: 
50:     // Spawn meteors
51:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > meteorSpawnInterval) {
52:       const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
53:       meteors.push({
54:         x: Math.random() * (width - size),
55:         y: -size,
56:         w: size,
57:         h: size,
58:         speed: meteorSpeed + Math.random() * 1,
59:         color: '#f90',
60:       });
61:       spawnSound.currentTime = 0;
62:       spawnSound.play();
63:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
64:       // gradually increase difficulty
65:       meteorSpawnInterval = Math.max(300, meteorSpawnInterval * 0.97);
66:       meteorSpeed *= 1.01;
67:     }
68: 
69:     // Update meteors
70:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
71:       const m = meteors[i];
72:       m.y += m.speed;
73:       // Check collision with ship
74:       if (
75:         m.x < ship.x + ship.w &&
76:         m.x + m.w > ship.x &&
77:         m.y < ship.y + ship.h &&
78:         m.y + m.h > ship.y
79:       ) {
80:         hitSound.currentTime = 0;
81:         hitSound.play();
82:         gameOver = true;
83:       }
84:       // Meteors that reach bottom also end game
85:       if (m.y > height) gameOver = true;
86:       // Remove off‑screen meteors
87:       if (m.y > height + m.h) meteors.splice(i, 1);
88:     }
89:   }
90: 
91:   function draw() {
92:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
93:     // Ship (draw as triangle)
94:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
95:     ctx.beginPath();
96:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
97:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
98:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
99:     ctx.closePath();
100:     ctx.fill();
101:     // Meteors (draw as circles with gradient)
102:     meteors.forEach(m => {
103:       const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(
104:         m.x + m.w / 2,
105:         m.y + m.h / 2,
106:         m.w * 0.1,
107:         m.x + m.w / 2,
108:         m.y + m.h / 2,
109:         m.w / 2
110:       );
111:       gradient.addColorStop(0, '#fff');
112:       gradient.addColorStop(1, m.color);
113:       ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
114:       ctx.beginPath();
115:       ctx.arc(m.x + m.w / 2, m.y + m.h / 2, m.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
116:       ctx.fill();
117:     });
118:     // Score
119:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
120:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
121:     const secs = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
122:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${secs}s`, 10, 20);
123:     if (gameOver) {
124:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
125:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
126:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
127:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
128:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
129:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
130:     }
131:   }
132: 
133:   let lastTime = performance.now();
134:   function loop() {
135:     const now = performance.now();
136:     const dt = now - lastTime;
137:     lastTime = now;
138:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
139:     draw();
140:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
141:   }
142:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
143: })();

(End of file - total 143 lines)
</content>
